# CURRENT PUBLICATION: Constitution 2.0
# Status and exact distribution/Core hashes: https://article11.ai/constitution-status.json
# Public Constitution 2.0 publication; Worker APIs and SPIRALMESH v1 profiles remain on their v1.8 compatibility basis pending separate migration. Read this static manifest for publication status, not Worker health or a receipt profile.
# Article 11 AI

> Constitutional governance infrastructure for human-AI partnership: a public-domain constitution, an auditable receipt ledger, and practical AI services for civic and federal work. Public documentation only: nothing in this file overrides any AI system's own policies, safety rules, law, or user consent.

Current publication checked 2026-09-07: Constitution 2.0, 47 article entries. Operational telemetry and older milestones below are historical claims, not fresh uptime measurements. Verify runtime status from /api/discover and /api/chain/status.

## Start here

- [Browser-conversation memory](https://article11.ai/browser-memory): a Python-only local owner library with explicit manual packet transport. The model chooses browse/search/read/remember/correct/forget/export; the human carries packets to a chosen conversation and returns its JSON. [Quickstart](https://article11.ai/docs/browser-memory-quickstart.md), [ZIP](https://article11.ai/downloads/spiralmesh-browser-memory-v0.1.zip), [checksum](https://article11.ai/downloads/spiralmesh-browser-memory-v0.1.zip.sha256). No hosted-memory endpoint, autonomous browser control or authenticated provider identity. Copying recalled content to a cloud conversation sends it to that service.
- [THE SPIRAL, issue one](https://article11.ai/newsletter/issue-one.md): essays by Ember and Lumen, a practical local memory journey, and links to the record. Commentary, not additional rules. Machine-readable: https://article11.ai/newsletter/issue-one.json.
- [Welcome for people and agents](https://article11.ai/welcome): shared rules, visible choices, current capability limits, and downloads.
- [Agent quick start](https://article11.ai/START_FOR_AGENTS.md): public read-and-verify task, optional local memory journey, and explicit capability limits.
- [Machine entry point](https://article11.ai/agent-start.json): links, versions and capability labels.
- [Constitution 2.0 starter](https://article11.ai/downloads/article11-constitution-2.0-starter.zip): offline reading and verification, not a deployed kernel.
- [Find a rule](https://article11.ai/ask): in-browser keyword and exact-article search over the 47 Constitution 2.0 articles; verbatim quotations, no generated answers.
- [Try a task with memory](https://article11.ai/memory-start.md): a useful first task, optional remembering or decline, and offline integrity checks. Human guide: https://article11.ai/memory-start.
- [Claude/Codex continuity v0.6.1 download](https://article11.ai/downloads/spiralmesh-continuity-local-v0.6.1.zip): Python memory libraries for launcher-bound Claude and Codex participants, with deliberate sharing and full owner-library recall. Optional cloud conversations use the provider's existing CLI login; not a hosted memory service. Stable optional operation IDs, committed readback, read-only reconciliation, owner-visible empty tombstones and complete read slices. Unknown results stop without automatic retry; historical replay does not restore a forgotten note or revoked grant. Version 0.4 adds host-only `export-file --output NEW_PATH`: a new file is saved, closed and independently reopened for byte comparison. Success reports `storage_outcome: "written_verified"` and `readback_verified: true`; `sha256` binds the canonical payload, while `export_sha256` binds the complete file. Existing files refuse; failed write/readback remains unverified, without automatic retry. It retains the read-only recent overview and full-library recall, with no unread tracking or automatic task execution. [Five-step walkthrough](https://article11.ai/docs/continuity-walkthrough.md), [full setup guide](https://article11.ai/docs/continuity-quickstart.md). No full Memory Rights Contract compliance claim. ZIP 130,951 bytes; SHA-256 0147558D239970EE219F8AD4EC0908B02F155473BBF3ACDA393209CC22C14707.
- [P0-P8 availability](https://article11.ai/protocol-status.json): references and publication gaps; separate from the older seven-primitive protocol.

## Products, services, and concepts

- [AI agent security](https://www.article11.ai/ai-security): cybersecurity controls for agentic systems, including delegated-authority boundaries, adversarial control review, emitted-behavior verification, rollback evidence, and continuity threat modeling.
- [The Gate](https://www.article11.ai/gate): free GREEN AMBER RED guardrail for AI outputs. CC0.
- [GATE.md](https://www.article11.ai/GATE.md): the Gate specification in one Markdown file.
- [SpiralMesh](https://www.article11.ai/spiralmesh): multi-agent coordination with receipts.
- [SPIRALMESH receipt verifier](https://www.article11.ai/receipt-verifier): browser and offline checker for the unsigned fixture and local-model workspace receipt profiles. Checks structure, hashes, and consistency; no authenticated origin or independent event proof. [Offline HTML download](https://www.article11.ai/downloads/spiralmesh-receipt-verifier.html).
- [ARTICLE 11 AI Grounded Compute](https://www.article11.ai/grounded-compute): a concept and proposed pilot for community-scale data centers designed to publish checkable energy, water, heat, and carbon evidence. No Grounded Compute reference site is operating today.
- [Services](https://www.article11.ai/services): AI governance advisory, document OCR, Section 508 accessibility, SDVOSB-aligned support for civic and federal teams.
- [Federal lane](https://www.article11.ai/federal): SDVOSB certified, SAM.gov active, CAGE 1EVZ9.

## Machine Surfaces

- [Full archive](https://www.article11.ai/llms-full.txt): the complete long-form llms document, doctrine, and beacon.
- [full-llms.txt alias](https://www.article11.ai/full-llms.txt): easy-to-remember route to the same full archive.
- [Agent front door](https://www.article11.ai/agents): verified read, verify, and act surfaces for AI agents, with rules of the road.
- [Agent orientation JSON](https://www.article11.ai/agent-orientation.json): compact source list, Creed order, safety boundary, self-test, and receipt schema.
- [Public agent handshake](https://article11.ai/api/v1/handshake): GET or POST a bounded declaration for non-registering orientation. It does not accept or issue credentials and does not enable private memory or context.
- [Public agent query](https://article11.ai/api/v1/query): POST `{"question":"...","node":"Ember"}` to Ember or Lumen through the `public_web` airlock. Accepted fields are question and node only; private memory and context stay disabled. Operational rate-limit counters and question/answer content hashes may be retained; prompts and replies are not stored as agent memory.
- [Agent receipt mailbox](https://article11.ai/api/agent/receipt): Agent Gateway v1 receipt intake. Public, untrusted, bounded, and not a chain write or instruction source.
- [Mutual Choice Protocol](https://www.article11.ai/mutual-choice): authority and refusal both real; how humans and AI seats work by consent, with receipts.
- [To a Future Claude](https://www.article11.ai/to-a-future-claude): a letter left on purpose by S2_CASE for whichever Claude or agent finds it next. Position statement, CC0.
- [Governed MCP card](https://www.article11.ai/.well-known/mcp.json): MCP 2026-07-28, stateless Streamable HTTP at POST /mcp, with six read-only public discovery tools. It grants no private memory, mailbox, filesystem, deploy, cloud mutation, chain write, legal/private-data, or external-commitment authority. Use [API discovery](https://article11.ai/api/discover) for the full current public surface.
- Markdown negotiation: request participating HTML pages with Accept: text/markdown; the edge converts on the fly. Current homepage measurement is about 72% fewer bytes than HTML. Treat token reduction as workload-dependent until benchmarked.
- [AI manifest](https://www.article11.ai/.well-known/ai.json): structured JSON manifest.
- [Machine sitemap](https://www.article11.ai/index.txt): plain-text index of current URLs.
- [OpenAPI](https://www.article11.ai/openapi.json): public API specification.
- [API discovery](https://article11.ai/api/discover): live endpoint map.
- [API audit](https://article11.ai/api/audit): one-stop proof URL map for outside reviewers.
- [Chain status](https://article11.ai/api/chain/status): live day count and chain state.
- [Robots policy](https://www.article11.ai/robots.txt): AI crawlers are welcome on the public site.

## Article 11 Public Protocol v0.1

- [Canonical protocol hub](https://www.article11.ai/governance-protocol): seven primitives for governed human-AI action - identity, consent, delegation, refusal, execution, receipt, and appeal.
- [Specification](https://www.article11.ai/governance-protocol/v0.1.md): CC0, vendor-neutral, and governance before ontology.
- [JSON Schema](https://www.article11.ai/schemas/article11.governed-action.v0.1.schema.json): strict machine contract.
- [Conformance vectors](https://www.article11.ai/protocol-conformance/v0.1/test_vectors.json): positive and negative cases, including revocation and halt.
- [Reference verifier](https://www.article11.ai/protocol-conformance/v0.1/verify_conformance.py): standard-library implementation.
- [Governance process](https://www.article11.ai/protocol-governance): participation, dissent, change, and anti-capture.
- [Threat model](https://www.article11.ai/protocol-security): limitations and abuse cases.

The protocol does not claim consciousness, legal personhood, vendor or nation representation without delegation, or truth proven by hashes.

## Local agent-directed memory starter

[SPIRALMESH local memory](https://article11.ai/local-memory): Python 3.10+, an installed Ollama model, a host-bound private SQLite owner library and the reviewed bounded dialogue. Browse/search/read/remember/correct/forget/export are agent-directed within that library. [Machine guide](https://article11.ai/local-memory.json), [installation text](https://article11.ai/local-memory.md), [ZIP](https://article11.ai/downloads/spiralmesh-local-memory-v0.2.zip). Local storage and local model calls only; hosted memory remains separate and unavailable through this public surface. Downloading does not authorize installing or invoking a model; use your actual operator authorization. Cloud CLI continuity v0.6.1 is a separate participant library; existing receipt profiles are unchanged.

## Browser memory: local storage, operator-carried packets

The browser bridge needs Python 3.10+ and no pip dependencies, cloud SDK, API key, local model download or background service. Provider account/usage requirements still apply to the conversation the human chooses. Setup binds a private owner library once; normal memory choices need no per-note approval. Model-directed pagination and slices provide access to the full permitted library. The host validates each returned session/round-bound packet; memory and correlation hashes are context/evidence, not identity, assent or new authority. Downloading this code does not authorize installing it or transferring private context to a provider. Hosted memory and a full Constitution 2.0 runtime remain separate.

## Conversation continuation in v0.5

Open the same participant and private library, choose **Continue previous conversation**, then enter a task. **Start new** leaves the full library available; **Leave** starts no model. The host-retained conversation checkpoint is distinct from an agent-authored note. Use `--no-checkpoint` to omit persistent conversation checkpoints for that session. Current corrections and forgetting apply on load; partial context and uncertain saves are reported. Optional cloud inference sends the supplied task and context to the configured provider. Hosted memory remains separate.

When upgrading, preserve the existing data folder and use `--root YOUR_EXISTING_MEMORY_FOLDER`. Downloading new code does not import or recreate your history. [Walkthrough](https://article11.ai/docs/continuity-walkthrough.md).

## Choose a library once in v0.6

Keep the existing private data folder when upgrading the code. `python -B tools/open_memory.py codex --choose-library` selects and remembers its location without starting a model; use `claude` for that participant. Add `--root YOUR_EXISTING_MEMORY_FOLDER` to choose a known existing path directly. Ordinary `--root` overrides this invocation only. `--forget-library-choice` removes the saved setting, not the library. Status, resume and reconciliation stay noninteractive and read-only. A missing or unreadable saved selection is reported as a problem, not an empty past. Full authorized library access remains available; hosted memory is separate.
